page.title: Northstar Air · Synthetic itinerary
page.source_contract: HTTP(S)-only page actions; temporary or exact-origin access

semantic_target.identity_rule: The provider binds documentId, elementRef, and elementFingerprint at inspect time; the HTML id is fixture wiring, not a public protocol selector.
semantic_target.runtime_fields_policy: Generated by the installed content script and redacted from public captures until CB-2 is proven.

action.target: The inspected Seat preference semantic target in the active synthetic tab

target_action.expected_change: Window → Aisle in the in-memory select control; no booking or navigation

verification.apply_contract: A side-panel-approved plan is consumed once after snapshot and semantic-target checks.
verification.postcondition: The fresh semantic page read-back reports seat_preference = aisle.

stale_mutation.trigger: Click User changes itinerary before applying the old plan.
stale_mutation.why_this_is_detectable: The fixture changes the semantic target shape and therefore its content-script fingerprint; a value-only change would not be presented as a stale-target proof.
stale_mutation.reset: Click Reset fixture; the page returns to v1 and the original semantic name.

negative_cases.mutation: Change the itinerary after inspection and before apply.
Call browser.apply twice with one approval.
Replace the select with a submit, payment, or download control.
negative_cases.evidence: The public provider allowlist blocks high-impact or unsupported controls.

claim_boundary: This is a labeled synthetic local fixture, not a real travel workflow or booking result.
CB-1 proves the fixture has stable semantic target intent, harmless reversible state, and a deliberate stale-target mutation aligned to the source contract.
The static page does not prove the installed Chrome extension, Native Messaging bridge, MCP round trip, side-panel rendering, or live apply/verify receipts.
A real capture must use a disposable local HTTP(S) origin and redact runtime IDs, digests, and page text before publication.
